latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix: added SameInstanceMatcher to handle an issue with equals method when using EqMatcher along with a mock to an object by @DOssaA in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1508
* Add scoped confirmVerified overloads for callables (KFunction and KProperty) by @DOssaA in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1513
* feat: support MockKAnnotation.useDependencyOrder for JUnit 5 by @ilia1243 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1515
* Allow updating settings from code by @Yentis in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1517
* Add currentThread filter and excluded mocks to clearAllStubsFromMemory by @evgenru in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1519
* Support new Kotlin annotation defaulting rule for @InjectMockKs by @ZzAve in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1525
* feat(dsl): Add context parameters support module (#1431) by @faraz152 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1521
* fix: resolve @InjectMockKs dependency order for interface by @neungs-2 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1526
* fix: resolve @InjectMockKs dependency order for list injection by @ilia1243 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1527
* fix: extract native lib from APK when not on filesystem (AGP 8.5+) by @snowykte0426 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1529
* fix: support OpenJ9 in JvmAutoHinter by @hspedro in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1530
* fix: prevent null packRef for value class with nullable inner value in sealed interface (#1326) by @snowykte0426 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1532
* fix: make clearAllMocks flags correctly isolate mock types (#1520) by @snowykte0426 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1533
* fix: incidental reflection of new platform apis crashes tests by @jzbrooks in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1531
* Update README.md by @Vixb1122 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1536
* fix: nullable value class issue in anyValue() by @micheljung in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1534
* Fix nested value class matching and capture on JVM by @snowykte0426 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1539
* Fix generic value class boxed type handling by @snowykte0426 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1541
* Preserve typed matcher checks for value class context by @snowykte0426 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1540
* fix: clear every mock kind in a single stub repository pass (#1546) by @renechoi in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1548
* docs: update JVM installation dependency to mockk-jvm by @Junaid-786-29 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1545
* fix: relaxed mock should throw exception by @matefoldes in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1544
* fix: don't let inline function detection break mocking  by @ch200203 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1549
* Document JDK 21+ dynamic agent warning solution (solves #1171) by @twhitmorenz in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1550
* fix(mockk): single non-reified slot() factory by @arimu1 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1551
* fix(mockk): report the verified call in unordered verification failures by @renechoi in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1552
* fix(build): skip Android modules in dokka when no Android SDK is present by @kdelay in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1556
* fix(mockk-agent): implement synthetic abstract methods in subclass proxies by @ethanstoner in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1557
* Fix coVerify on spyk of a suspend SAM interface leaking Continuation by @jadhavgaurav in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1558
* fix(mockk): make negative verifications honour the whole timeout by @dlwhdgus0810 in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1559
* fix(mockk-agent): inline synthetic static methods so mockkStatic can stub them by @kdelay in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1560
* fix(mockk): give each any<Class<*>>() matcher its own signature value by @ethanstoner in https://github.com/mockk/mockk/pull/1561
* fix(mockk): estimate call rounds from the unboxe
